Jayaprakash Kotha, MBBS, PhD


harshitha.rv@f…


Thu, 11/19/2026 - 04:19


JP Kotha joined Fortrea in October 2026 as Vice President of Bioanalytical Services, bringing extensive experience leading bioanalytical laboratory operations and delivering scientific support for clinical development. His experience spans pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, biomarkers, and immunogenicity testing for biopharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. Dr. Kotha is an accomplished medical researcher and scientific leader with 28 years of academic and industry research experience. Throughout his career, he has focused on translating scientific innovation into practical bioanalytical solutions that support clinical trials and drug development. Prior to joining Fortrea, JP served as the Vice President of Bioanalytical Operations at Worldwide Clinical Trials and as Vice President of Translational Research at MLM Medical Labs. Earlier, as a Senior Scientific Officer at CirQuest Labs, he played a key role in establishing the company’s translational research services to support the biopharmaceutical industry, with a particular focus on cardiovascular and oncology research. His academic and clinical research experience also includes positions within the Department of Medicine at the University of Tennessee Health Science Center and the Department of Clinical Virology at Christian Medical College and Hospital. JP earned his PhD in Cellular & Molecular Biology from the University of Tennessee Health Science Center and holds an MBBS from Guntur Medical College.
